name: dotfiles-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server over the dotfiles workstation governance surface: MCP policy audit, agent operating profiles, workstation attestation and fleet status.

security.note: Every tool is read-only and runs a fixed `dot` argument vector without a shell. Mutating paths (`dot mode set`, `dot attest --write`) are deliberately not exposed. The only write any tool causes is the audit-log line `dot mode` appends for every invocation, human or otherwise.

tools.name: mcp-doctor
tools.description: Validate MCP configuration, policy, and supply chain

tools.name: fleet-status
tools.description: Show fleet node status and drift
